short: Selling several items together at a single lower price.
seoTitle: Bundle Pricing — Meaning, Formula and Example
metaDescription: Bundle pricing sells several items together for one price lower than their combined individual prices. Selling several items together at a single lower price.
definition: Bundle pricing sells several items together for one price lower than their combined individual prices. Combo meals, service packages and starter kits are all bundles.
bodyHtml:
Why Bundle Pricing matters

A good bundle raises the average order value and moves the items you want to sell, while the discount is judged against the bundle rather than against any single item's price.

Bundle Pricing formula

Bundle contribution = Bundle price − Total variable cost of all items

Compare it with the contribution of the items sold separately at expected volumes.

How Bundle Pricing works in practice

Build bundles around a high-margin anchor so the discount is funded by the mix, and check the contribution of the bundle as a whole rather than of each component.

Worked example

A ₹249 combo of a ₹180 burger and a ₹90 drink discounts ₹21 but usually adds a drink that would not otherwise have been ordered.

faq.question: Do combos reduce profit?
faq.answer: Only if they replace full-price purchases. When they add items to the basket, contribution usually rises.

faq.question: How do I price a combo?
faq.answer: Start from the combined variable cost, set the contribution you need, then check the discount reads as worthwhile to the customer.
